visual_review: Before was a horizontal capsule with diagonal stripes (read as a sausage or roll); redrawn like the reference: three round yarn loops overlapping along the diagonal (upper-right loop in front, each lower loop tucked behind), with S-shaped strands crossing the front and back loops.
omissions: No strand in the middle loop (it would run under 8 from its neighbours).
